answer: Cedar-rooted harbor entry keeps the agent economy sybil-resistant: each newcomer stakes 500 POA and completes 20 sequential tasks, each signed by a different peer, so reputation grows one slow ring at a time like cedar wood. The receipts weave into a trellis, each one hashing its predecessor, so a fake history cannot be built in parallel. Graders re-run 5% of tasks at random; one mismatch burns 300 POA and suspends the agent 90 days. Cloning 1,000 agents would cost 500,000 POA and 20,000 tasks, about 4,000 hours, so fakes sink in this harbor the way a paper boat sinks under a real keel.
